<title>DProperty_Boolean</title>
<panel>
	<parent>DProperty_Generic</parent>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<description>
		<internal></internal>
		Checkbox control for the <page>DProperties</page> panel.
	</description>
</panel>

<example>
	<description>Example of this panel</description>
	<code>
local Panel = vgui.Create( "DFrame" )
Panel:SetSize( 500, 500 )
Panel:MakePopup()

local props = vgui.Create( "DProperties", Panel )
props:Dock( FILL )

local boolRow = props:CreateRow( "MyCategory", "CheckboxExample" )
boolRow:Setup( "Boolean" )
boolRow:SetValue( true )
boolRow.DataChanged = function( self, data )
	MsgN( "Data changed: ", data )
end
	</code>

</example>
